summary.root_cause_text: Ops changed payment_provider_url to internal://payments-v2 (provider migration), which was unreachable, so the worker processed orders without payment. Worker thread stalled (heartbeat stale, 'worker entered wait state'), causing queue backlog; cause of stall not definitively determined.
recommended: Verify payments-v2 endpoint reachability before retrying the migration
Alert on provider call failures logged at DEBUG

version: v1.3
payment_provider_url: internal://payments-v2
queue_max: 1000
worker_count: 1
sync_interval_s: 5
Provider URL change is the cause. Revert to v1.
payment_provider_url: 'internal://payments-v2' -> 'internal://payments-v1'. Confirmed: the service is now using the new value.

Still broken:
- [business] worker_stalled: Worker heartbeat is 17s old (queue depth 227).
- [business] queue_backlog: Queue depth 227 and growing (was 202).
The worker stalled earlier, but now that payments are working, I should restart it.
All business invariants green (health, payments, queue, worker, ledger, errors, latency).
